Commentary.Commentary: THE MATCH HAS BEEN ABANDONED. The rain gods did not have any mercy and it kept pouring down. It got bright for a while but that was the only positive sign which did not last long either. Even once the rain stopped, the ground conditions were just too wet. The umpires had no choice but to call it off. So we now move to 2nd of this 3-match T20I series between the two. The 2nd game will be played on Friday, 12th July. That game begins at 1600 Local (1500 GMT). Join us for that one. Till then, cheers.
